svg.title: Lookout decision lifecycle
svg.desc: A personal agent progresses through discovery, applications, tracking, networking and interview preparation. All stages share persistent state; human feedback updates state before agent resumption. This is a conceptual workflow, not an automatic backend state machine.
svg.text: Each stage reads / writes shared state
Conceptual lifecycle. Workflow transitions and wake delivery depend on task policy and the agent runtime.
